rationale: Price has drifted below the 9-EMA and the tight 10.96 consolidation seen on the 1-minute tape since entry, producing no positive excursion and a fresh low at $10.90 while the bid sits at $10.87. Although the tape remains above VWAP and broad risk-on conditions persist, the immediate rejection at the entry zone and lack of continuation through the upper 71% range position erase the mechanical long edge that existed at entry.
